stem:
Complete the following activity to find the value of \(x\):
\(5x + 3y = 9\) ...... (I)
\(2x - 3y = 12\) ...... (II)
Add equations (I) and (II) and hence find \(x\).
Complete the following activity to determine the nature of the roots of the quadratic equation \(x^2 + 2x - 9 = 0\).
solution:
Compare \(x^2 + 2x - 9 = 0\) with \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\): \(a = 1\), \(b = 2\), \(c = -9\).
\(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac = (2)^2 - 4 \times 1 \times (-9) = 4 + 36 = 40\).
Since \(\Delta = 40 > 0\), the roots of the equation are real and unequal.

subtopic: Shares — Face Value, Market Value, Brokerage
stem:
Complete the following table using the given information:

| Sr. No. | FV | Share is at | MV |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ₹100 | Par | ? |
| 2 | ? | Premium ₹500 | ₹575 |
| 3 | ₹10 | ? | ₹5 |
| 4 | ₹200 | Discount ₹50 | ? |
solution:
Using MV = FV + Premium (at premium), MV = FV − Discount (at discount), and MV = FV (at par):

| Sr. No. | FV | Share is at | MV |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ₹100 | Par | ₹100 |
| 2 | ₹75 | Premium ₹500 | ₹575 |
| 3 | ₹10 | Discount ₹5 | ₹5 |
| 4 | ₹200 | Discount ₹50 | ₹150 |

Row 1: at par MV \(=\) FV \(=\) ₹100. Row 2: FV \(=\) MV \(-\) Premium \(= 575 - 500 =\) ₹75. Row 3: MV \(<\) FV, so the share is at Discount \(=\) FV \(-\) MV \(= 10 - 5 =\) ₹5. Row 4: MV \(=\) FV \(-\) Discount \(= 200 - 50 =\) ₹150.

stem: Solve the following simultaneous equations: \(x + y = 4\); \(2x - y = 2\).
solution: Add the two equations: \((x + y) + (2x - y) = 4 + 2 \Rightarrow 3x = 6 \Rightarrow x = 2\). Substitute in \(x + y = 4\): \(2 + y = 4 \Rightarrow y = 2\). \(\therefore x = 2, y = 2\).

stem: Write the following equation in the form \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\), then write the values of \(a\), \(b\), \(c\): \(2y = 10 - y^2\).
Write an A.P. whose first term is \(a = 10\) and common difference \(d = 5\).
solution: The terms are \(a, a+d, a+2d, a+3d, \ldots\) i.e. \(10, 15, 20, 25, \ldots\)

stem: A courier service agent charged a total of ₹590 to courier a parcel from Nashik to Nagpur. In the tax invoice the taxable value is ₹500, on which CGST is ₹45 and SGST is ₹45. Find the rate of GST charged for this service.
solution: Total GST \(=\) CGST \(+\) SGST \(= 45 + 45 =\) ₹90 on a taxable value of ₹500. Rate of GST \(= \dfrac{90}{500} \times 100 = 18\%\).
